# Disease Outbreak Detection

## Overview

This project focuses on detecting unusual disease patterns from surveillance data.

## Objectives

-   Detect outbreaks early
-   Reduce false alarms
-   Improve public health response

## Methods

-   Time-series analysis
-   Anomaly detection
-   Forecasting

## Results

The system identified abnormal spikes several weeks before official reports.
